stillBlocks: live bank use or readiness claims

criteria.requirement: A supported share sale completes through the web and FastAPI.
criteria.expectedResult: The guided owner sale flow uses the generated investments client and one authenticated investments workflow to persist the canonical sale result.
observedEvidence: Both complete gates passed 505 backend, 126 web, and 37 contract boundary tests plus production builds and the 17/17 owner-browser gate; the web action submits through the generated investmentsRecordShareSale client and FastAPI returns the canonical persisted sale result.

criteria.requirement: FIFO allocations, remaining lots, and ledger effects match characterization fixtures.
criteria.expectedResult: One transaction locks canonical lots oldest-first with stable-ID tie breaking, persists cent-exact allocations and remaining balances, and posts the characterized gain/loss entry through ledger's public contract.
observedEvidence: The canonical sale suite passed 30 backend and 36 web tests, and the real PostgreSQL 17 lifecycle passed 9/9 in both complete gates with FIFO order acquisition_date/id, a 5-share NOK 100.00 allocation, NOK 20.00 gain, and exact 20-share/NOK 400.00 residuals.

criteria.requirement: Overselling and invalid sale data fail atomically.
criteria.expectedResult: Oversale, incomplete lot history, invalid values, stale or duplicate commands, wrong tenant, and ledger failure produce coded errors and no allocation, lot, position, sale, ledger, receipt, bank-match, or audit fragment.
observedEvidence: Policy and database tests reject zero/negative proceeds, invalid dates/counts, incomplete lot history, cross-tenant access, stale/reused identities, and overselling; a forced wrong-entry completion after a real ledger post rolls back the sale, allocations, position/lot changes, ledger entry, receipt, legacy action, and audit as one transaction.

criteria.requirement: Purchase and sale behavior collaborates internally within one investments capability and uses only approved external public contracts.
criteria.expectedResult: Purchase and sale share the investments public vocabulary and persistence port; the backend workflow depends only on investments and ledger public contracts, with opaque provider-neutral bank/document references.
observedEvidence: Public-contract, module-boundary, generated-client, role, RLS, and real database tests passed twice; purchase and sale share investments commands/persistence and the sale workflow invokes only ledger's PostInvestmentSaleCommand with opaque optional source references.

criteria.requirement: Duplicate TypeScript/SQL sale and FIFO rules plus active-slice compatibility code are removed.
criteria.expectedResult: One Python investments implementation remains; legacy sale/FIFO RPCs, coordinators, TypeScript policy, and the exact #142 allocation-read compatibility scope are removed after reconciliation and rollback/recutover, without entering #143 early.
observedEvidence: The TypeScript sale/FIFO modules and legacy Python sale engine are deleted; the old ledger HTTP sale route, browser RPC, predecessor production names, and exact #142 allocation-read compatibility record are absent after reconciliation. Real PostgreSQL proves the predecessor remains executable during overlap and after repeat-safe rollback, then contracts cleanly again; both linked complete gates passed.
